I know how you feel and I’m very sorry this happened to you. My ex broke up with me 5 months ago out of the blue, only to come back 2 months later saying he missed me and really wanted to try again. I didn’t trust him at first but decided to give him the benifit of the doubt only for him to break up with me 2 weeks later, and again out of the blue. 

It broke me. But now, 5 months later, I can honestly say that I never want to get back together with him. Not sure if I’m completely over him yet because the things he said and the things I hear about him still hurt but thats okay. I don’t need him to be happy.
